# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server, 2026-10-16: client-probes/probe_pronebones
# with probe_spot mound on mp_carentan, one prone client, placed twice. Each PROBE
# bone line is a script_origin linked to that bone, read a frame after the
# pose it shows. The FALL lines are the client's snapshots whose prone body
# (fTorsoHeight, fTorsoPitch, fWaistPitch) is non-zero; its cmds ran 16, 16
# and 18 ms apart, one on each frame's time, through the second drop.
# COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_DIR=<1.5 install> COD_LNXDED_HOME=<abs> PORT=31995 SECS=27 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_pronebones mp_carentan +set probe_spot mound +set probe_hold 0
